question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word ABSENT (in both forward and backward directions) which have as many letters between them as there are in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96291a8b1de2db52fcfb74bccf5293b6f4b8b1050b0ebc66086a0b732fafb0ce.png]

ABSENT 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d40815af6518c571a49618d2c220137fcb37ef537aaed6d44cc8d588c0a39a5.png] 

There is only one pair in alphabetical order,

Hence, the correct answer is '**One'.**
